subject: IDS 2026 — Spain dealer compare v1.3 (map)
body:
Dear colleague,

Please find attached the IDS 2026 dealer compare pack for Spain (v1.3).

What is included
• Offline HTML: IDS_2026_dealer_compare_Spain.html
• Zip: IDS_2026_Spain_v1.3.zip
• Scope: Spain dealers only (45) — other countries are not visible
• UI: no Country filter / By country tab (single-market pack)
• Map tab: Leaflet pins; hover shows dealer total score vs the Spain national average (and the delta in percentage points)
• Network average charts still use the full IDS 2026 network as an anonymous benchmark (no other dealer names)

Open the HTML with an internet connection so map tiles can load.

Kind regards,
Jérôme Van der Pluym
